evidence: Touches src/kernel/bitcoinkernel.cpp and directly addresses kernel library requirements by removing the reliance on a single global logger instance.
rationale: Enables multi-instance and isolated logging streams necessary for libbitcoinkernel consumers. The PR description notes that a single global log stream 'limits functionality of libbitcoinkernel, forcing all potential users of the library... to use shared global state and not be able to do things like get an isolated log trace from one operation.'
